messages.text:
Happy to help. What are you after, a home miner you can run quietly, or something bigger?

And roughly what budget are you working with?

The Harlo H15 Dual is $999. It does 15 TH/s on Bitcoin plus 1.08 GH/s Scrypt for Doge and Litecoin, around 500W, about 50 dB, built-in PSU, wifi or ethernet. Plug is matched to your address.

https://heliumdeploy.com/products/harlo-h15-dual

Want me to check the current ship date on it, or build you a cart?

Straight with you: the H15 is still a pre-production sample on its way to Harlo for testing, so there's no confirmed ship date on it yet. I won't guess one.

Cart's ready if you want to hold a unit: ····

You can follow it at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Want something that ships sooner instead, or is the dual Doge/BTC the whole point for you?
